notes.title: Price change
notes.notes:
Due to exchange rate fluctuations and financial difficulties, the price of "illusion" will be changed.

[u]The price of "illusion" will be changed from ＄4.99 to ＄4.89.[/u]

We apologize for the sudden change.
The price change will be made in November.
We will also hold Steam sales from time to time. Thank you for your cooperation.

The price of "Headache 頭痛" will not be changed. It will remain free.

notes.notes:

・Added a new checkpoint at the start of the 2nd round and beyond.
